intended_object: A bookkeeping map that turns a top cell at refinement level N (a top orbit together with a length-N refinement word), plus an extra length-L refinement word, into a top cell at level N+L by concatenating the two words. This is read off the docstring and the body.
explanation: `TopCell hp N` is an internal index type of the library, defined as `TopOrbit hp × RefinementWord p N`. `appendRefinementWord` concatenates two words with `Fin.addCases`. So `endpointTopCell` keeps the orbit component and appends the second word to the first. It is a reindexing step in the library's iterated-subdivision prism argument, an implementation detail of the proof with no standalone counterpart in the literature. The body matches the docstring: it reindexes a cell at level N as a top cell at level N+L.
